consent_questions.label: Consent questions
consent_questions.required: At least one consent question is required

info.title: Fixed answers: I consent / I do not consent
info.description: The respondent answers every question below with "I consent" or "I do not consent" (translated into their language). All questions must be answered "I consent" to continue; answering "I do not consent" to any of them shows the rejection message and ends the survey.

actions.toggle_fallback_confirm_description: This changes which Info & Consent is used as fallback for this survey.
